answer: A newcomer starts as a closed lotus bud: it may trade at once, but its earnings rest in a shared oasis pool for a month. Each trade leaves a signed receipt in the ledger, and each new receipt references two earlier ones, weaving a trellis no fake can forge without real counterparties. Two auditors check the trellis within 48 hours of each payout; a duplicate means the whole pool is clawed back, the reporter takes a cut and the identity is banned. One honest agent waits weeks for full pay; a thousand fakes must build a thousand real histories, then lose it all on one detection.
